$description: The single source of sokkel-ui tokens. `tidevann`, the base theme, defines every token; every other theme overrides what it changes, and may override any token, not only colors. scripts/build-tokens.ts writes the CSS.

$parts.$description: The tokens a theme sets to give one part of the frame its own look. Each defaults to what the part drew before it had one, so a theme that sets none looks as tidevann does.
$parts.control-radius: the corners of a control (a button, a field, a select, a toggle), from --radius
$parts.surface-radius: the corners of a surface (a card, a boxed section, a popover, a menu, a dialog), from --radius
$parts.typeface-heading: the face of page, section and dialog titles
$parts.section-head-ground: the ground of a boxed section's head and a panel's head
$parts.section-head-line: the rule under a boxed section's head
$parts.section-head-ink: the ink of a section's or pane's title; currentcolor keeps the text color around it
$parts.page-title-ink: the ink of a page's title; currentcolor keeps the text color around it
$parts.table-head-ground: the ground of a table's or listing's head row
$parts.table-head-line: the rule under a table's head row
$parts.table-head-ink: the ink of a table's column heads
$parts.table-zebra: the ground of every other row of a table; the card, so no stripe, unless a theme sets one
$parts.editor-ground: a wash over the code editor's and a code block's own ground; transparent leaves theirs
$parts.editor-gutter: a wash over the code editor's gutter, and a code block's line numbers
$parts.editor-gutter-ink: the ink of the code editor's line numbers
$parts.scroll-thumb: the thumb of a scroll area, and of the browser's scroll bars where `scrollbar` names it
$parts.scroll-track: the track of a scroll area, and of the browser's scroll bars where `scrollbar` names it
$parts.scrollbar: the browser's own scroll bars: `auto` as the browser draws them, or a thumb and a track color such as `var(--scroll-thumb) var(--scroll-track)`
$parts.page-foot-ground: the ground of the shell's foot strip and the rail's corner beside it
$parts.page-foot-line: the rule over the shell's foot strip
$parts.page-foot-ink: the ink of what the foot strip says
$parts.palette-inset: the room between the command palette's edge and its rows
$parts.palette-row-inset-x: the room at a palette row's ends, and before a group's title
$parts.palette-row-inset-y: the room over and under a palette row's text
$parts.caption-size: a video's caption text at its usual size, against the player's width (`cqw`); a viewer's chosen size scales it
$parts.caption-size-min: the smallest caption text, however small the player or the chosen size
$parts.caption-white: the captions' ink unless the viewer picks another (`caption-yellow`, `caption-green`, `caption-cyan`, `caption-magenta`)
$parts.caption-edge: the outline and drop shadow around caption text
$parts.caption-ground: the box behind caption text, when the viewer asks for one, see-through or solid

tidevann.$description: Cool gray surfaces and one calm blue. The default.

light.typeface-sans: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif
light.typeface-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
light.terminal-bar: color-mix(in oklab, var(--terminal-accent) 6%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--terminal-foreground) 9%, var(--terminal)))

amber.$description: The default surfaces under a warm amber accent.

paper.$description: Warm paper surfaces and an amber ink, the way a printed form reads.

contrast.$description: Pure white or black grounds: the widest separation between text and surface.

tokyo.$description: Blue-gray dusk surfaces under a bright blue accent.

vinyl.$description: Warm cream surfaces and a deep brick red.

cassette.$description: Neutral grays and an orange accent.

neon.$description: Violet-tinted surfaces and a hot pink accent.

ocean.$description: Deep sea blues and teal, with softer corners.

indigo.$description: An indigo accent on cool neutrals.

terminal.$description: Green on black in the code face, and a light console by day.

light.typeface-sans: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

dark.typeface-sans: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

derived.$description: The surfaces every theme but tidevann derives from its own colors, so each carries its theme's tint. A theme that sets one of these itself keeps its own value. Tidevann sets them as fixed colors.

density.$description: Layout spacing per density, answered on [data-density]: regular, and compact for a denser screen. page-inset is the wide inset where the nearest container (the shell's content, or the window) is 40rem or wider, and the narrow one below it. overlay-inset is the room a popup keeps from the window's edges, the narrow page inset.
